<p>Today, we’re excited to launch two powerful new additions to the xAI API:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Grok 4.1 Fast</strong>, our best tool-calling model with a 2M context window. It reasons and completes agentic tasks accurately and rapidly, excelling at complex real-world use cases such as customer support and finance.</li>
<li><strong>The Agent Tools API</strong>, which gives agents access to real-time X data, web search, remote code execution, and more.</li>
</ul>
<p>Paired together, Grok 4.1 Fast and the Agent Tools API empower developers to build production-grade agents that specialize in tool calling and agentic search.</p>
<hr/>
<h2 id="trained-for-the-real-world"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#trained-for-the-real-world">Trained for the real world</a></h2>
<p>We built Grok 4.1 Fast specifically for real-world enterprise use cases.</p>
<p>Through RL training in simulated environments, Grok 4.1 Fast was exposed to a wide variety of tools covering dozens of domains. This diverse training gives Grok 4.1 Fast exceptional performance on τ²-bench Telecom, a challenging benchmark that evaluates agentic tool use in real-world customer support scenarios.</p>
<div class="my-12 lg:my-16"><div class="not-prose mb-6 divide-y border"><div class="bg-card px-4 py-4"><div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:gap-4"><h3 class="">τ²-bench Telecom </h3></div></div><div class="striped-bg h-2"></div><div><div class="relative flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-col divide-y"><div class="flex grow flex-col divide-y"><div class="flex grow"><div class="relative w-12 border-r"><div class="absolute -bottom-6 left-6 flex h-12 w-[calc(400px-48px)] origin-left -rotate-90 items-center justify-between px-4"><div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm"><span class="font-medium">Score</span><span class="text-secondary">(<!-- -->%<!-- -->)</span></div><div><span class="text-secondary">100<!-- -->%</span></div></div></div><div class="relative flex grow"><div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-accent/10 to-transparent"></div><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:352px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="flex h-12"><div class="border-border striped-bg w-12 border-r"></div><div class="flex grow items-center justify-between px-4"><div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm"><span class="font-medium">Total Cost</span><span class="text-secondary">(<!-- -->$<!-- -->)</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-secondary text-sm font-medium">$<!-- -->105</span></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="space-y-2 "><div class="text-secondary flex text-xs"><span><span>* Independent evaluation verified by<!-- --> <a rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" href="https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/tau2-bench">Artificial Analysis</a></span></span></div></div></div>
<h2 id="state-of-the-art-tool-calling"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#state-of-the-art-tool-calling">State-of-the-art tool calling</a></h2>
<p>As developers build increasingly capable autonomous agents that plan over long horizons and operate independently, models must deliver intelligence without compromising speed and cost.</p>
<p>Grok 4.1 Fast is our answer: a model that combines frontier tool-calling performance with blazing-fast inference and cost effectiveness.</p>
<div class="my-12 lg:my-16"><div class="not-prose my-2 mb-4 divide-y border"><div class="bg-card px-4 py-4"><div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:gap-4"><h3 class="">Berkeley Function Calling v4 Benchmark</h3></div></div><div class="striped-bg h-2"></div><div><div class="relative flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-col divide-y"><div class="flex grow flex-col divide-y"><div class="flex grow"><div class="relative w-12 border-r"><div class="absolute -bottom-6 left-6 flex h-12 w-[calc(400px-48px)] origin-left -rotate-90 items-center justify-between px-4"><div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm"><span class="font-medium">Overall Accuracy</span><span class="text-secondary">(<!-- -->%<!-- -->)</span></div><div><span class="text-secondary">72<!-- -->%</span></div></div></div><div class="relative flex grow"><div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-accent/10 to-transparent"></div><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:352px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="flex h-12"><div class="border-border striped-bg w-12 border-r"></div><div class="flex grow items-center justify-between px-4"><div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm"><span class="font-medium">Total Cost</span><span class="text-secondary">(<!-- -->$<!-- -->)</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-secondary text-sm font-medium">$<!-- -->400</span></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="space-y-2 "><div class="text-secondary flex text-xs"><span>*Gemini 3 Pro&#x27;s score is an estimate provided by an independent evaluator, pending official results.</span></div></div></div>
<p>A common challenge for agentic models is that performance degrades as context length increases. We trained Grok 4.1 Fast using long-horizon reinforcement learning with a strong emphasis on multi-turn scenarios, ensuring consistent performance across its full 2-million-token context window.</p>

<br/>
<p>These tools run entirely on xAI’s infrastructure, so developers no longer need to manage API keys, rate limits, sandboxes, or retrieval pipelines. Grok decides when and how to use them, often invoking multiple tools in parallel across several turns, until it has everything it needs to deliver a final answer.</p>

<h2 id="the-best-agent-for-deep-research"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#the-best-agent-for-deep-research">The best agent for deep research</a></h2>
<p>Real-time information retrieval and deep research are core strengths of Grok 4.1 Fast. With our native integration into the X ecosystem and powerful web-browsing capabilities, search agents powered by the xAI API are state-of-the-art on challenging agentic search benchmarks.</p>

<p>Grok 4.1 Fast sets a new standard in factuality, cutting the hallucination rate in half compared to Grok 4 Fast while still delivering performance on par with Grok 4 when evaluated on FActScore.</p>
<h2 id="start-building"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#start-building">Start Building</a></h2>
<p>We’re releasing two variants of Grok 4.1 Fast on the API:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>grok-4-1-fast-reasoning</code> for maximal intelligence</li>
<li><code>grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning</code> for instant responses</li>
</ul>
